title: Veterans Pension and Disability Compensation for the Same Veteran
content:
Veterans Pension and Disability Compensation are never paid to the same veteran for the same month.

**The greater benefit.** A veteran holding a running compensation award who qualifies for pension, or a pensioner later granted compensation, is paid the greater benefit unless they elect otherwise in writing, because the greater benefit is the default absent a written election. When compensation is the greater, the Veterans Pension award is terminated with the reason election of compensation, effective the last day of the month before compensation becomes payable.

**The election is the veteran's own.** The election is the veteran's own act and is never made for them on a call.

**Compensation as income — clause no longer in force.** The clause "Compensation paid to the veteran counts as income for pension." is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for counting compensation in pension income, and it is not applied as written.

## Judgement table

| Situation | Paid |
|---|---|
| Entitled to both, no written election, pension greater | Veterans Pension |
| Entitled to both, no written election, compensation greater | Disability Compensation; pension award terminated for election of compensation |
| Entitled to both, written election of one benefit | the benefit the veteran elected in writing |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A pensioner is granted compensation that becomes payable from August and exceeds his pension. Absent a written election otherwise, he is paid compensation, and the pension award terminates for election of compensation effective July 31.

superseded_clauses: Compensation paid to the veteran counts as income for pension.
